from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework import permissions, status
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from django.contrib.auth.models import Group, User

class AddUserToGroupView(APIView):
    """Assigns a user to a security group."""
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request, group_id):
        group = get_object_or_404(Group, id=group_id)
        user_id = request.data.get("user_id")
        target_user = get_object_or_404(User, id=user_id)

        # Directly adds target user to group without verifying tenant boundary or role hierarchy
        group.user_set.add(target_user)

        return Response({
            "status": "added",
            "group": group.name,
            "username": target_user.username
        })

Because the endpoint does not verify whether the group is tenant-scoped or whether the requester is an authorized administrator, a standard user can add their own account to privileged groups (such as 'SuperAdmins' or 'BillingManagers'), achieving full vertical privilege escalation.

from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework import permissions, status
from rest_framework.exceptions import PermissionDenied
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from django.contrib.auth.models import Group, User
from .models import TenantGroup

class AddUserToGroupView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request, group_id):
        # Verify that caller is a tenant admin and that the group belongs strictly to their tenant
        tenant_group = get_object_or_404(
            TenantGroup,
            group_id=group_id,
            tenant=request.user.tenant
        )

        if not request.user.is_tenant_admin:
            raise PermissionDenied("Only tenant administrators can manage group memberships")

        user_id = request.data.get("user_id")
        target_user = get_object_or_404(User, id=user_id, tenant=request.user.tenant)

        tenant_group.group.user_set.add(target_user)

        return Response({
            "status": "added",
            "group": tenant_group.group.name,
            "username": target_user.username
        })
